## Make Trellis disappear

Trellis should not be part of the NMP programming model. #2626 already says Trellis is private reconciliation machinery and that app/native/web callers still use NMP-owned session handles, typed feed declarations, typed projections, and action/capability surfaces.

Even that wording is a bit too leaky. The public version should be:

```text id="8f0569"
NMP owns active reads.
NMP may use Trellis internally to reconcile resources.
No app-facing type, doc, or generated helper mentions Trellis.
``` [...] Keep private only:
- ObservedProjectionSink
- source reducers
- typed snapshot projection registration
- Trellis adapter
- InterestShape / LogicalInterest machinery
- replay-before-live internals
```
